admission.justification: Guards against another task or evidence-copy contract aborting a canonical task-document publication, while preserving a named fail-closed path when own copy ownership cannot be established.

applicability: Enclosure-position candidates encountered by the repository enclosure-walk consumers, with a task artifact available for membership assessment.
conditions: Repository tasks membership is derived from the physical enclosure position and filesystem-resolved artifact/root paths.
exclusions: Unknown ownership of an unreadable or unparseable artifact: each consumer keeps its own failure policy.
Notes/archive evidence is excluded by enumeration rather than parsed as an enclosure.
statement: A contract whose task document filesystem-resolves outside its positional repository tasks folder is skipped and named wherever a walk meets it, whether or not its worktree group still exists.
